title: dedicated-fleet-autoscaler-burst-throttle-util-reporting
author: Anika Rao
description: Motivation: production Dedicated fleets observed transient latency spikes when burst traffic exhausts token-bucket capacity; existing reporting did not surface per-fleet burst throttle and queued-request metrics, making postmortems and autoscaler tuning difficult. This PR introduces a burst-throttle smoothing policy, adds per-fleet throughput and queued tokens telemetry, and surfaces utilization breakdowns in the fleet dashboard so SREs and product teams can reason about latency vs. cost tradeoffs.  What this change does (summary): 1) implements a smoothing wrapper around the existing token-bucket (tokenbucket/smoother.go) that reduces oscillation by applying an exponential moving average to available tokens; 2) exposes new metrics (fleet_burst_throttle_{count,seconds}, fleet_queue_length, fleet_utilization_breakdown) with labels for fleet_id, region, and capacity_tier; 3) augments the autoscaler decision loop to consider short-term burst debt (tokens deficit) when making scale-up decisions to avoid repeated micro-scale events; 4) adds a new admin API endpoint (/v1/admin/fleet/{id}/utilization) for on-demand utilization snapshots used by the Console; 5) improves logging and adds structured events for throttle/fallback actions to aid incident analysis; 6) adds end-to-end integration tests that replay production-shaped traces.  Compatibility and rollout: default behavior is unchanged (smoother is opt-in via fleet policy field burst_smoothing: "enabled|disabled|auto"). For existing customers the server defaults to "auto" which enables smoothing only for fleets with observed oscillation patterns. The admin API is permissioned under existing RBAC scopes. Migration notes: no model or serving contract changes.  Checklist: - [x] unit tests for tokenbucket smoothing and metrics - [x] integration test (replay trace scenario) - [x] telemetry schema registered and doc updated - [x] Console Dashboard PR queued (redwood-docs #internal) - [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-7421, ENG-8050)  Related work: builds on prior burst-reporting efforts in pr-428901 and pr-468210; addresses gaps discovered in post-incident review for INC-2026-02.
